Envorso Sports is building the platform that runs a professional sports team's entire fan-facing business: ticketing, website, mobile app, and increasingly commerce, CRM, and marketing, from one system instead of six disconnected vendors.

Today, most teams run a fragmented stack: a website vendor, a ticketing provider, a separate mobile app, CRM tools, marketing automation, and game-day engagement solutions bolted together. Teams don't want to pay five vendors and contractors to stitch the data together. That creates a disconnected fan journey and leaves revenue on the table.

Our platform is live today with the Seattle Seawolves of Major League Rugby, and the league itself is now on the platform, with individual teams onboarding through the season.
